hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults (EVC). Handles the full swap execution in beforeSwap: computes quotes against vault reserves, deposits input tokens into Euler supply vaults, and withdraws output tokens — bypassing standard Uniswap v4 pool liquidity. Blocks external LP positions, donations, and supports optional pool expiration via block.timestamp.
